name: get_vercel_ci_invocation_tree
description:
Get a Vercel CI invocation attempt with all its job definitions, each job's latest run, and the task definitions and active task runs of that run. Defaults to the latest attempt when attempt is omitted. With follow=1, the call waits until the attempt finishes or the stream reaches its maximum duration, then returns the collected stream events.

CLI fallback on MCP failure (partial): vercel api /v1/vercel-ci/invocations/{invocationId}/tree --method GET. Fill placeholders from inputs.

attempt.description: Invocation attempt to return. Defaults to the latest attempt.

follow.description: When 1, stream the tree as newline-delimited JSON until the attempt finishes.

slug.description: Team slug to use for this operation. Use instead of teamId.

teamId.description: Team ID to use for this operation.
